verdict.rationale: Netlify's own docs describe built-in on-demand image transformation with automatic content negotiation, and its homepage shows an image being resized to 800px wide. Together these cover the resize and optimize core of the story as a first-party platform feature. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of transformation parameters (formats, quality, fit/crop), explicit evidence that transformed images are cached and served from the CDN, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can resize and optimize images on demand via a built-in image CDN

citations.quote: Transform images on demand without impacting build times. Handle content negotiation automatically.
Deploy to a global CDN in seconds
